name: Lint
command:
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --no-default-features -- -D warnings
cargo clippy --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --bins -- -D warnings

name: C header syntax
command:
cc -std=c11 -fsyntax-only -x c include/csgrs.h
c++ -std=c++17 -fsyntax-only -x c++ include/csgrs.h
c++ -std=c++17 -fsyntax-only -x c++ ../../bindings/cpp/csgrs.hpp
